Waiting for the hub: open the app at hom.en: Waiting for the hub: open the app at home once, near a computer of the group.

When the phone is not on the home networ.en: When the phone is not on the home network, it syncs through the WireGuard tunnel of your own hub, a computer of the group set up with cbb global hub; its port is reachable from the internet, but only through WireGuard with the group's keys. The hub answers this phone the next time it connects at home. Nothing goes anywhere else, and without the tunnel there is no connection. Turning it off forgets this phone's tunnel key.
